change.scope: Expose the fail-closed Scientific Validation Gate through the API and Workbench.
change.intent: Make release-blocking scientific evidence visible as a first-class product surface without converting missing evidence into PASS.

evidence: Versioned /v1/scientific-validation endpoint evaluates the existing fail-closed gate.
Workbench has a dedicated Scientific Validation view.
Dashboard reports benchmark blockers and source-probe provenance separately.
